result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly around content being clipped or obscured at the screen edges and by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant feed content. The second card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the nav bar, making the image and potentially card actions harder to see or tap.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation plus safe-area inset, so cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable items are cut off at the right edge, including the category chip row and the “Fastest near you” restaurant cards. This may be intentional carousel peeking, but it looks abrupt because text such as the third restaurant name is visibly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel spacing and consider adding a subtle fade, snap alignment, or ensuring partially visible cards do not show clipped text labels.

issues.description: Some secondary text and icons use light gray on a light background, such as the search placeholder and inactive bottom navigation labels, which may be difficult to read for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast for placeholder text and inactive navigation labels/icons while keeping the visual hierarchy clear.
